in_arabic.name: Adeema
in_arabic.long_meaning: Adeema هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic word 'adimah' which means 'exalted', 'noble', or 'sublime'. In Islamic context, it can be associated with the virtues of being humbly reverent towards Allah, the Exalted.
